item.name: Retrieve detailed information of a specific member-client relationship

request.description: Fetches comprehensive details of the association between a member and a client using the provided unique identifier.

response.name: Describes details of member and client

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Update information of a specific member-client relationship

request.description: Modifies details of the association between a member and a client based on the provided data.

response.name: Describes details of member and client

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Remove a specific member-client relationship from the system

request.description: Deletes the association between a member and a client using the provided unique identifier. Once deleted, this relationship data can't be recovered.

response.name: Describes details of member and client

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Fetch a list of member and client associations

request.description: Retrieve a detailed list showcasing all the existing associations between members and clients in the system.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Establish a new association between a member and client

request.description: Use this endpoint to create a new linkage between a member and client in the system, allowing for better relationship management.

response.name: Describes details of member and client
